Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.

7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants.
2021-01-27 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Approve As-Needed Construction Management Services Contracts. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute contracts (Attachments 1-5 of the agenda report), and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with Dudek, Kleinfelder, WSP, Infrastructure Engineering Corporation, and Psomas, each in a total not to exceed cost of $250,000 for As-Needed Construction Management Services.
2021-01-27 Item 08B As Needed Construction Management Contracts
8C.
Approved As-Needed Civil Engineering Services Contracts. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute contracts (Attachments 1-6 of the agenda report), and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with Dokken, Kimley Horn, Rick Engineering, Michael Baker International, NV5 and STC. Each contract will be for a total not to exceed cost of $250,000 for As-Needed Civil Engineering Services.
2021-01-27 Item 08C As Needed Civil Engineering Contracts
8D.
Contract Amendment #5 for Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) to Provide Additional Design and Permitting Services on Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project (CC04J). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract amendment and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) in the amount of $617,988 plus 15 percent contingency of $92,698 for a not-to-exceed contract amount of $710,686 to perform additional design and permitting services for the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project (Attachment 1 of the agenda report). If approved, the total not-to-exceed amount authorized by City Council for this contract and all amendments would be $2,106,418.
2021-01-27 Item 08D Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Amendment #5
8E.
Establishment of a Labor Compliance Program for Proposition 84 funding on Leucadia Streetscape Phase 1 (CS04D). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Adopt Resolution No. 2021-02 entitled, “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas To Establish a Labor Compliance Program for Use of Proposition 84 Funds on the Leucadia Streetscape Phase 1 Project” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-01-27 Item 08E Prop 84 Labor Compliance Program Streetscape Phase 1
8F.
Fiscal Year 2020-21 First Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Assistant Finance Director Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2020-21 First Quarter Budget Status Report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-09 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget.” (Attachment 1 of the Agenda Report)
2021-01-27 Item 08F First Quarter Budget Report and Proposed Amendments
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of the Final Environmental Impact Report (EIR), adoption of the Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program (MMRP) and California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Findings of Statement of Overriding Considerations prepared for the demolition of an existing single-family home and greenhouse structures to create a four-lot subdivision, and to construct a 250-unit residential development (210 market rate and 40 very low affordable), a farm stand market, farm-to-table restaurant with on-site alcohol service as an accessory use, agricultural uses, private recreation center and event venue/space, grading and landscaping improvements and the use of three temporary construction trailers. CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003524-2019, SUB-003526-2019, DR-003528-2019 & CDP-003529-2019; APPLICANT: Brian Grover, Nolen Communities; APPELLANT: Paul Kibel, Encinitas Community Trust; LOCATION: 1150 Quail Gardens Drive (APN: 254-612-12). Contact Person: Principal Planner Colamussi
Deny the appeal and adopt Resolution No. 2021-06 (Attachment 01A) affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the Final EIR with the MMRP and CEQA Findings of Statement of Overriding Considerations and to approve the project.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
